items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Who? Leelo Robiner. Yeah, Leelo Robiner, yeah. You don't know him. He saxophone player too. He played tenor. He played the piano. I don't play piano.

ctx.x: Did he go down to New Orleans and work?

Oh yeah, he used to play all about it. He used to play with Marshall, yeah. He was in California, huh? He was in California, huh? He was in California, huh? He was in California. Who? Leelo Robiner. Yeah, Leelo Robiner, yeah. You don't know him. He saxophone player too. He played tenor. He played tenor. Did you play on that stuff? No. He played the piano. I don't play piano. I'll give it up to you, Rob. I'll pull it up to you.
Let's get your name down. I don't think I did get it. The Valentine. You're another Valentine, though. That's my son. You're a junior then, huh? Yeah. Oh, I see.
